notes: Tightens the verified lower bound on |CS>^4 from 4 (bounds/CS-m4-lower-4.json) to 5 (5 <= chi(|CS>^4) <= 9 with bounds/CS-m4-upper-9.json, matching the monotonicity floor implied by bounds/CS-m3-lower-5.json under budget_s: 3600 while certifying m=4 directly in ~8 s warm / ~24 s cold with Numba JIT on 1 core under the default 900 s budget). Applying (<0|_2 (I (x) H))^4 to |CS>^4 yields (1/64)|Psi_4> with |Psi_4> = (2|0> + (1+i)|1>)^4 in Z[i]^16 (verified symbolically on all 256 -> 16 amplitudes against stabrank_verify.target_vector('CS', 4)), so chi(|CS>^4) >= chi(|Psi_4>). On D_3 (1,080 states), verify_challenge/cert_cs_m4_rank5_exact.py enumerates all 2,297 S_3-reduced minimal rank-4 decompositions of |Psi_3> over Hadamard-certified F_P (P = 1,000,000,009 > 2,000,000 Cramer/Hadamard norm bound) and checks all 32^2 x 32^2 phased 3-qubit Pauli slice-1 matches, finding 0 lifts, paired with the explicit 5-term Z[i]^16 tightness witness showing chi(|Psi_4>) = 5.
